label: Median days listed (active for-sale listings)
source: Bayut residential for-sale listings snapshot (Hugging Face: pelegelraz/DubaiRealEstateSalesInsights), matched to communities by Bayut area name
provenance: Third-party scrape of Bayut. Listing-side data, not transactions. 41,381 for-sale listings with posting dates; 27,228 belong to a Bayut area that maps to a Dubai community (the rest are in other emirates or in umbrella districts too broad to place).
period: snapshot as of 2024-04-25 (listings posted Dec 2021 to Apr 2024)
join: Bayut publishes one placeholder coordinate per marketing area rather than per listing, so listings are assigned by area name. Each area was placed in the community containing its placeholder point, with three hand corrections (Downtown Dubai to Burj Khalifa, International City to Warsan First, Dubai Islands to Nakhlat Deira) and ten umbrella districts excluded. Several Bayut areas can map to one community (e.g. Dubai Marina, JBR, Bluewaters and Dubai Harbour all sit in Marsa Dubai).

method: For each community, the median number of days between a listing's posting date and the snapshot date, across listings still active at the snapshot. Communities with fewer than 10 matched listings are null.
limitation: Measures how long CURRENT listings have been on the market, not how long sold homes took to sell (sold listings drop out before they can be counted, so true time-to-sale is longer). Re-posted listings restart the clock. Snapshot is April 2024 and may not reflect the current market.
